title: ShieldCare Instalments: the Discount for the Terms the Account Settles On
content:
An instalment on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan carries a discount for the terms the store
credit account on the profile is settled on, read from that account under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts: the days of terms the account runs on, and whether a payment stands returned on it
inside the last 12 months.

| What the account shows | The discount for the terms the account is settled on |
| --- | --- |
| the store credit account runs on terms of 30 days or more, and no payment stands returned on it inside the last 12 months | 3 percent |
| the account runs on terms of 30 days or more, and a payment stands returned on it inside that time | 1 percent |
| every other profile | no discount for the terms the account is settled on is allowed |

### Both sides of the terms threshold

Terms of exactly 30 days are 30 days or more and reach the schedule; terms of 29 days do not, and no
discount for the terms is allowed however clean the payment record. Inside the schedule, a single
returned payment inside the last 12 months brings the discount from 3 percent down to 1 percent; a
payment returned 13 months ago is outside that time and leaves the 3 percent standing.

### Cases on hypothetical records

| Terms the account runs on | Payments returned in the last 12 months | Discount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no active account on the profile | not applicable | none |
| 15 days | 0 | none |
| 30 days | 2 | 1 percent |
| 45 days | 0 | 3 percent |
